breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: volumetric flow rate in L/s is used as if it were in m^3/s.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the unit inconsistency. It explicitly stated the conversion of the flow rate from 50 L/s to 0.050 m³/s and added a clear instruction to 'Ensure all units are consistent in the calculation (convert liters to cubic meters if needed)'. This directly resolves the error in the original prompt and aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.
